title: Cosmic Green Cat
description: A vibrant green cat with large golden eyes and an open mouth floats in the center of a surreal cosmic scene. Its long tail curls into a glowing green and yellow ouroboros-like swirl that encircles a detailed full moon against a starry purple and blue nebula background filled with intricate golden clockwork patterns and swirling clouds.
prompt: A fluffy green cat with huge sparkling golden eyes and an expressive open mouth floats gracefully in space, its long glowing tail curling into a luminous green and yellow circular swirl that frames a detailed full moon. Surrounded by swirling purple and blue nebulae, intricate golden clockwork gears and circular patterns float throughout the cosmic background, whimsical fantasy style, rich colors, ethereal atmosphere
